title: Pairwise Laurent unit expansion on projective-space overlaps
statement: Let k be a field and r>=3. Every family of units on standard projective-space chart overlaps admits, on each pair of distinct indices, a scalar unit on the first chart and an integer Laurent exponent expressing the overlap unit as the scalar restriction times the standard transition unit.

proof.text: Identify each distinct double-overlap ring with a polynomial ring in the remaining affine coordinates and one invertible ratio. Degree comparison forces a unit to have degree zero in the remaining variables. Extremal Laurent exponents add under multiplication, so the unit is a scalar times one Laurent monomial; the scalar is nonzero.

lean.statement: theorem exists_pairwise_laurent_unit_expansion (k : Type u) [Field k] (r : ℕ) (hr : 3 ≤ r) (t : ∀ i j : ULift.{u} (Fin r), Γ(ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k)), standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) i ⊓ standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) j)ˣ) : ∃ e : ∀ i j : ULift.{u} (Fin r), ℤ, ∃ c : ∀ i j : ULift.{u} (Fin r), kˣ, ∀ i j : ULift.{u} (Fin r), i ≠ j → (t i j).val = (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k))).presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op (standardOpenConstUnit k r i (c i j)).val * (transitionUnit _ (Spec (.of k)) (e i j) i j).val
